releaseValidation: The Server 0.10.2 release gate tested each of the twenty retained registry-downloaded client packages against the released contract 3.2 conformance bundle for its exact SA target: 20 released-package pairs. The fourteen published 0.5.0, 0.5.1 and JavaScript 0.5.2 packages, which require contract 3.0, passed all 15 fake-SDK conformance scenarios and the optional large-result scenario against the server (224 scenario runs); the six published 0.4.0 packages, which require contract 2.0, were rejected before launch, which proves installation/startup rejection only. This was the first release gate to run the JavaScript 0.5.2 packages. The twelve published 0.2.0/0.3.0 packages are retired from the live gate. Server artifact hashes in every report match the published conformance ZIPs. Earlier released-package pairs (18 pairs against 0.10.1, 192 scenario runs; 12 pairs against 0.10.0, 90 scenario runs; 54 pairs against 0.9.0, 0.9.1, and 0.9.2, 216 scenario runs; 36 pairs against 0.6.1 to 0.8.0, 432 scenario runs) and 42 development-candidate pairs remain recorded with their original identities. Licensed SpatialAnalyzer validation was not run for this change.
